title: Bonus Analysis: The Anglerfish Principle - Understanding Deceptive Lures
content: Deep Dive Analysis: How cybercriminals use irresistible lures just like anglerfish in the deep ocean. Complete this analysis to earn bonus points.
body_html:
BONUS LEVEL: NATURE'S LESSONS

The Anglerfish Principle

IN THE DEEP OCEAN

The deep-sea anglerfish has evolved a remarkable hunting strategy. It possesses a bioluminescent lure that dangles in front of its mouth, glowing in the pitch-black depths. Smaller fish, attracted to the light, swim toward it expecting food or a mate. Instead, they become the anglerfish's meal.

THE CYBERSECURITY CONNECTION

Phishing attacks work exactly the same way. Cybercriminals create irresistible lures:

  • Financial Lures:You've won $1,000,000 or Urgent invoice overdue
  • Security Lures: Your password expires today or Account suspended
  • Package Lures:Your delivery is waiting or Shipping confirmation
  • Emotional Lures:Someone has a crush on you or Emergency help needed

Just as the anglerfish's glowing appendage is designed to trigger an instinctive response in prey, phishing emails are designed to trigger an emotional response that bypasses rational thinking.

YOUR ANALYSIS TASK:

Review the 5 phishing emails below and identify the type of lure each uses. Then complete the analysis worksheet attached.

BEGIN ANALYSIS

Bonus points: 500 Estimated time: 15 minutes

title: Urgent Family Emergency - Stuck in London Need Help
content: Hi, it's your cousin Sarah. I'm stranded at Heathrow after getting robbed. My wallet and phone were stolen. Can you help with hotel and flight money?
body_html:
Hi Jen,

I'm so sorry to email you like this but I'm in a really bad situation and need your help urgently.

I'm in London for the conference and got mugged on the tube this morning. They took my backpack with my wallet, phone, passport, everything. The police helped me file a report but I'm stuck at Heathrow with no money and no way to get to the hotel or fly home.

I'm using a computer at the airport info desk but they're closing soon. I need about $950 for a hotel tonight and a flight home tomorrow. The airline said they can hold a seat if I pay within 2 hours.

Can you please help me? I'll pay you back the moment I get home. I already tried Mom but she's not answering her phone.

Western Union transfer details:

Name: Sarah Chen
Destination: London, UK
Transfer to: Heathrow Airport branch

Please let me know when you send it. I'm so grateful for your help.

Love,
Sarah

Sent from Heathrow Airport Information Kiosk Temporary email access
